steps.title: Hire Prototype Engineer with a three-part brief
steps.instructions: Fill in the agent's brief: what it should be, the sizes, loads and limits, and how it will be made. The agent designed, checked and documented the part without follow-ups.
steps.prompt:
What should it be? A desk phone stand that holds a phone at two viewing angles (for video calls and for reading), with a slot so the charging cable can stay plugged in.

Sizes, loads and limits: fits phones 65–80 mm wide and up to 11 mm thick, including in a case; stays put when tapping the screen; footprint under 90 × 90 mm.

How will it be made? FDM printing in PLA on a 220 mm bed, without supports, and no screws or glue.

artifacts.label: Pre-build report: targets, dimensions, print setup, checks, statics, limits and the physical tests still needed
Editable parametric CadQuery source: named dimensions, model, exports and checks, statics, renders and the build script
Geometry check results (50 of 50 passed) and the build and check log
Reading position with phone and plug envelopes
Base underside with the cable channel

preview.description: A two-part, screwless, support-free PLA phone stand with video-call and reading angles and a cable slot, delivered as editable CadQuery source, STEP and STL files, and a report that is honest that nothing has been printed yet.
